notes: AliceSoft System 4.x: System40.ini is the runtime's ini, next to the <game>.ain bytecode (https://github.com/nunuhara/xsystem4); .afa (AFAH) is the System4-era AliceSoft archive (https://morkt.github.io/GARbro/supported.html).
